message.name: ENGAGEMENT_STATUS
message.description: Engagement guidance status. Carries the estimated time-to-impact used by the ground station to display an abort countdown during a terminal engagement run.
message.field: Engagement state: 0=INACTIVE, 1=DIVE, 2=RECOVER.
Estimated time until impact. NaN if not estimable.
Slant range from the vehicle to the target. NaN if unknown.
Closing speed along the line of sight, positive when closing. NaN if unknown.
1 if time_to_impact is a usable estimate, 0 otherwise.

message.name: VISION_ENGAGEMENT_STATUS
message.description: Vision-aided engagement guidance status. Line-of-sight regulation state and the range/time-to-impact estimates used by the ground station during a camera-guided terminal run.
message.field: Guidance state: 0=SEARCH, 1=TRACK, 2=COAST, 3=TERMINAL, 4=ABORT.
Azimuth line-of-sight error from boresight, positive right.
Elevation line-of-sight error from boresight, positive below.
Slant range estimate to the target. NaN if unknown.
Closing speed along the line of sight, positive when closing. NaN if unknown.
Estimated time until impact. NaN if not estimable.
1 if time_to_impact is a usable estimate, 0 otherwise.
Track confidence 0..255 (255 = 1.0). 0 when no lock.

message.name: NEXAM_TARGET_SELECT
message.description: Operator visual target designation from the ground station to the companion tracker. Sent once when the operator selects (click or drag) a target on the live video.
message.field: Selection box top-left X, normalized 0..1 (0 = left edge).
Selection box top-left Y, normalized 0..1 (0 = top edge).
Selection box bottom-right X, normalized 0..1.
Selection box bottom-right Y, normalized 0..1.
System id that should run the tracker (companion computer).
Component id that should run the tracker (companion tracker).
Selection action: 0=CANCEL (stop tracking), 1=SELECT (start tracking).
Monotonic selection id, incremented on each new designation.

message.name: NEXAM_TARGET_TRACK
message.description: Tracked target state streamed from the companion tracker to the ground station, once per processed frame, so the operator sees the live tracked box on the video.
message.field: Tracked box top-left X, normalized 0..1.
Tracked box top-left Y, normalized 0..1.
Tracked box bottom-right X, normalized 0..1.
Tracked box bottom-right Y, normalized 0..1.
Track confidence 0..1. NaN if not provided by the tracker.
Tracker status: 0=IDLE, 1=TRACKING, 2=LOST.
Selection id this track corresponds to.

message.name: NEXAM_TRACKER_CONFIG
message.description: Operator ROI-scoping and on/off configuration from the ground station to the companion tracker. Defines a centered region-of-interest (ROI) the tracker searches WITHIN before it emits a NEXAM_TARGET_TRACK box, and whether tracking is enabled at all. The ROI is a box centered at (roi_center_x, roi_center_y) whose size is expressed as roi_size, the ROI diagonal as a fraction of the full-frame diagonal. Unlike NEXAM_TARGET_SELECT this is not a target designation: it constrains the search region, it does not pick a target.
message.field: ROI center X, normalized 0..1 (0 = left edge). Default 0.5.
ROI center Y, normalized 0..1 (0 = top edge). Default 0.5.
ROI diagonal as a fraction of the full-frame diagonal, 0..1.
System id that should run the tracker (companion computer).
Component id that should run the tracker (companion tracker).
Tracking enable: 0 = tracking disabled, 1 = enabled.
Reserved/monotonic config id, incremented on each update (kept for symmetry with the other NEXAM messages).

message.name: PN_ENGAGEMENT_STATUS
message.description: PN-ENG terminal guidance status. Carries the entry-gate verdict, the line-of-sight solution, and the actuator-authority margin for the proportional-navigation engagement mode, so the ground station can display an abort countdown and distinguish a gate reject from a lost target.
message.field: Slant range from the vehicle to the target. NaN if no valid target solution.
Horizontal range to the target. This is the quantity the entry gate tests against PNE_GATE_RMIN/RMAX.
Closing speed V_c along the line of sight, positive when closing. The PN term is gated off when this is not positive.
Line-of-sight bearing from the vehicle to the target, 0 = North, clockwise positive.
Line-of-sight depression below the horizon, positive down. Tested against PNE_GATE_LOS at entry.
Estimated time until intercept. NaN if not estimable, which is the normal case before the closing-speed regulator has converged.
Specific thrust magnitude ||a_des - g|| the mode is demanding.
Authority floor at the current airspeed. When u_mag falls below this the allocator loses control margin; this is the quantity whose breach produced the terminal departures in logs 390/391.
Predicted normalised collective, MPC_THR_HOVER * u_mag / g0. Approaching zero means the motors are about to clip.
Predicted thrust-axis tilt from vertical. Bounded by PNE_TILT_MAX. This is the thrust axis, not the pitch attitude.
Horizontal speed. Below PNE_VH_MIN while descending faster than PNE_VZ_VRS the vortex-ring-state guard arms.
Effective commanded closing speed after the entry ramp and the VRS guard have been applied to PNE_V_DES.

Status bitmask. Bit 0: target solution valid this cycle. Bit 1: entry gate satisfied. Bit 2: terminal freeze latched (committed). Bit 3: authority floor exceeds what the airframe can produce. Bit 4: VRS guard active. Bit 5: PN command clamped by PNE_MAX_G. Bit 6: tilt clamped by PNE_TILT_MAX. Bit 7: authority floor scale-up active. Bits 8-15 reserved, send 0.
PN-ENG state: 0=INACTIVE, 1=GATE_REJECT (entry gate not satisfied, holding hover), 2=GUIDING, 3=TERMINAL (inside PNE_R_MIN, guidance frozen), 4=RECOVER (target solution lost, holding hover).
